notes.source: src/requestHandler.ts:376-378 (fix parent) const path = decodeURIComponent(req.path.slice(req.path.indexOf("/", 1) + 1)) - the Express route path of /vault/{path}
notes.sink: src/requestHandler.ts:382 this._vaultGet(path, req, res) (and _vaultPut/_vaultPatch/_vaultPost/_vaultMove) - the decoded path is handed to the vault adapter's read/write/delete calls outside this file
notes.between: Express routes /vault/* before the handler, so a literal ../ is normalised away, but '..%2F' survives routing; decodeURIComponent then turns %2F into '/', reconstituting the traversal. No path was resolved or confined to the vault root. The fix adds extractVaultPath(), which decodes, posix.resolve()s against a synthetic '/vault' root and rejects anything outside it with 40021. Second explanation: check (the added containment test).
notes.fix: decodes in one helper and refuses paths whose posix.resolve() falls outside the vault root

notes.source: server/rest/index.js:50-54 (fix parent) const name = ponse.getPathName(request); name.replace(apiURL, '') - the request path under /api/v1; onGET strips the leading '/' into cmd (lines 125-126)
notes.sink: server/rest/index.js:130 streamPack(root(cmd, rootDir), p.response, packer) - the path is packed and streamed; streamPack() splits it with path.dirname/path.basename and calls operation('pack', ...)
notes.between: response middleware -> rest() -> sendData() -> onGET() -> streamPack() -> the packer. root() only maps web separators (mellow.webToWin) and does no containment, so a percent-encoded ../ in the GET path reaches the packer and archives files outside rootDir. notes.source: the basePath argument of SkillParser.parseZipPackage/findSkillMd, derived from the GitHub repository URL path segment typed into the agentSkills.importFromGitHub endpoint (authenticated)
notes.sink: apps/server/src/services/skill/parser.ts:203-205 (fix parent) const basePathPattern = new RegExp(`^[^/]+/${basePath.replaceAll(/^\/|\/$/g, '')}/SKILL\\.md$`) - user input compiled as a regular expression, then tested against every archive entry

notes.source: routes/mobileconfig.js:8-12 (fix parent) url.parse(req.url, true).query.udid, and line 20 req.cookies.newudid - the query parameter or the cookie it was stored in
notes.sink: routes/mobileconfig.js:15 res.cookie('newudid', query.udid, ...) puts the raw value into the Set-Cookie header, and line 23 res.render('udid', { udid: cookie }) renders it; views/udid.pug:6 is p #{udid}
notes.between: the query value is stored in a cookie for 10 minutes, then read back on the next /enrollment request and rendered. Before the fix neither step checked the value; the fix adds extractValidUdid() (the existing UDID regex) before setting the cookie and before rendering, plus httpOnly and secure. The rendering itself is Pug's escaped interpolation, so the HTML sink does not by itself explain the XSS: what is missing is whether the advisory's sink is the template or the Set-Cookie header carrying the unvalidated value. Second explanation: source (cookie).
notes.fix: allowlists the UDID shape before storing it in the cookie and before rendering it, and marks the cookie httpOnly/secure in production
